lines.name: Caron Simply Soft Solid Yarn
lines.description:
Wrap yourself in comfort and luxury with this ever-popular soft yarn. The weight, luster and sheen of this yarn simply has no equal. In knit or crochet, the drape of Simply Soft makes it the right choice for garments and throws alike. A premium yarn that delivers on the details—no dye lot solids plus machine washable and dryable.
 
Weight: Medium (4)
 
Contents: 100% acrylic
Skein Weight: 6 oz. / 170 g
Yardage: 315 yd. / 288 m
 
Knitting Gauge:
18 sts - 24 rows = 4" (10 cm)
Crochet Gauge:
13 sc - 14 rows = 4" (10 cm)
 
Suggested Knitting Needle:
5.00 mm, US - 8
Suggested Crochet Hook:
5.00 mm, US - H/8

lines.name: Caron Groovy Cloud Cakes Yarn
lines.description:
Caron Groovy Cloud Cakes are a light and fluffy addition to the Caron Cakes line of yarns. The fleecy texture comes in a versatile worsted weight and is machine washable and dryable for easy care. Stitch up some delectable home décor treasures with fun retro flair and enjoy the delicious softness. Caron Cloud Cakes has a lightly brushed look that lends your projects a soft gleam.


We understand the importance of dye lots and will try to match dye lots for your order, however, we cannot guarantee all skeins will be the same dye lot. 


Weight: Medium (4)


Contents: 100% polyester

Skein Weight: 8 oz. / 227 g

Yardage: 720 yd. / 658 m


Knitting Gauge:

20 sts - 26 rows - 4" (10 cm)

Crochet Gauge:

16 sc - 20 rows = 4" (10 cm)


Suggested Knitting Needle:

4.5 mm, US - 7

Suggested Crochet Hook:
